description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'git am' command with different scenarios related to quoted CRLF handling. It sets up test cases, executes 'git am' with various options, and checks for expected outcomes.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the provided commands, and verifies the results.

methods.name: test_might_fail
methods.description: Defines a test case where failure is acceptable, runs commands expecting possible failure.
